attributes.action: Ban public firework sales and restrict use to licensed organised displays
attributes.additional_details: Fireworks cause unnecessary distress to babies, young children, autistic people, those with PTSD, elderly residents, pets and wildlife. Unpredictable explosions can trigger anxiety, sensory overload and fear. Fireworks also pose risks of injury, fires and antisocial behaviour. We are not asking for celebrations to end, but for fireworks to be restricted to large, registered events with trained professionals, strict safety measures and advertised dates and times so communities can prepare.
attributes.background: We want the UK Government to ban the sale and use of fireworks by the general public, allowing them only at large, officially registered events run by licensed professionals. This would help protect children, vulnerable people, pets and wildlife from distress, injuries and unpredictable explosions.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
